description: A React component for uploading and confirming license key upgrades in the Mattermost admin console, including modal UI, file handling, and success/error states.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles file input change, updates state with selected file.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles license upload submission, manages upload state, error handling, and success state.

methods.name: handleOnClose
methods.description: Closes the modal if not uploading, triggers onExited callback if provided.

methods.name: handleRemoveFile
methods.description: Removes the selected file from state.

methods.name: displayFileName
methods.description: Formats the filename for display, truncating if necessary.
